overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that content focusing on complex or dynamic marital relationships (husband-wife) significantly outperforms parental, sibling, or generic sad poetry formats. Specifically, titles addressing marital realities ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') achieved views above 1,600, whereas standard sibling or generic shayari videos struggled below 250 views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos centered on husband-wife understanding and post-marriage realities generated 1,600+ views (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1,766 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1,671 views).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on core relationship and marriage tension topics under the 'रिश्ते' and 'ओवरथिंकिंग' pillars.

weak_patterns.evidence: Clips focused on sibling love or raw sad poetry ('जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा…' or duplicate sister videos) received under 150 views and minimal engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic sad shayaris and overly saturated sibling tropes; shift focus entirely toward intimate relational dynamics.
